maket.atis.not: Release to shoot · pinch to zoom, twist to turn · power is a test value
maket.bulmaca.3: The ball runs along the goal line. It slips past the near post, then banks off the corner at the far post into the goal. A ball that goes behind the post stops in the side netting.
maket.bulmaca.7: The lane is the narrow channel behind the seats. The corner at an empty seat drops the ball through the gap one row down; two rows are descended this way. The hole is in the channel of the lowest row.
maket.bulmaca.14: Zigzag between the partitions. The floor slopes towards the drain; the hole is the drain itself. A ball in the puddle counts as out (test value).

maket.yerlesim.alt: To scale: pitch {0} × {1}. The coral shapes show the real size of the holes.
maket.yerlesim.not: {0} holes at real size (1–5 grass, 7 concrete step, 14 tile). The other {1} holes are in the old language and will be redrawn.
maket.bulmaca.1: The lane bends along the centre circle line. The ball leans on the outer edge once and follows the curve; hitting forward is enough.
maket.bulmaca.2: The lane runs from inside the pitch to the touchline; its end is open, the line itself is the boundary. The hole sits just before the line: too much power sends the ball out (counts as out, TRIAL).
maket.bulmaca.4: The lane turns the corner from the touchline onto the goal line. The corner flag post stands in the middle of the turn: the ball goes round its outside and bounces off the angled edge.
maket.bulmaca.5: Breather. A short lane from the penalty area line to the penalty mark; the hole is the mark itself. The curved back edge turns a ball coming from the start onto the mark.
